text: INRS method qualitative control-banding approach assessing risk inhalation chemical agents, developed French National Research Safety Institute (INRS). title: UNE-EN 689: Quantitative Statistical Exposure Assessment
text: UNE-EN 689 European standard defines two-stage statistical procedure comparing measured occupational exposure levels occupational exposure limits (OELs). designed provide statistically rigorous reproducible conformity decision based representative set exposure measurements collected multiple working days. standard assumes daily exposure (ED) values follow lognormal normal distribution uses one-sided upper tolerance limit (LSC_{95,70}) decide, 95% confidence 70% coverage, whether exposure OEL.

title: UNE-EN 689: Quantitative Statistical Exposure Assessment
text: measurement day produces one samples. daily exposure ED calculated time-weighted average 8-hour shift. exposure index IE = ED / OEL computed day. Decision rules:

what: Stage 2: Statistical assessment (minimum 6 measurement days total)
title: UNE-EN 689: Quantitative Statistical Exposure Assessment
text: full set ED values (preliminary + additional days) fitted lognormal normal distribution using Shapiro-Wilk test. one-sided upper tolerance limit LSC_{95,70} compared OEL via risk index UR. UR ≥ UT (tabulated tolerance factor), conformity declared.
